prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. This crate applies Ohm's law. `voltage(i, r)` returns `i * r`, `current(v, r)` returns `v / r`, and `power(v, i)` returns `v * i`. Every argument must be finite; resistance must be strictly positive, and voltage/current must be non-negative. Otherwise return `Err("invalid")`. Keep the public signatures and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
